claim@1.summary: Claim the item so no other session builds it at the same time.

start@1.summary: Move the item to its in-progress status.

branch@1.summary: Create the item's branch from its working base.

build@1.summary: Build the item on its branch and hand back what was deferred, changed or dismissed.

risk-check@1.summary: Check the finished build for the risks its changes carry, and fix or raise what it finds.

local-checks@1.summary: Run the repository's local checks on the final tree and leave a receipt.

review@1.summary: Review the change with the configured reviewers and settle every finding.

merge@1.summary: Land the reviewed change on its target.

complete@1.summary: Record the landed work on the item: its status, dates, links and claims.

capture@1.summary: File the follow-up work the build, the risk check and the review left untracked.

sync@1.summary: Bring the working base up to date and confirm the tree is clean.

custom@1.summary: A repository's own step: it passes, fails or holds, with evidence.

hotfix-preflight@1.summary: Check the working tree and name the hotfix branch from the repository's config.

hotfix-branch@1.summary: Cut the hotfix branch from the production branch and push it.

hotfix-stage@1.summary: Name the environment this checkout deploys to, and stop before touching a production one.

hotfix-environment@1.summary: Bring the local environment back to production code: a backward transition.

hotfix-report@1.summary: Report the cut in one line and say what comes next.

hotfix-fix@1.summary: Make the smallest change that fixes the production problem, then commit and push it.

hotfix-merge@1.summary: Merge the reviewed hotfix pull request into the production branch, only on the person's yes.

deploy-approval@1.summary: Approve the production deploy of one merge, only on the person's yes for that merge.

deploy-confirm@1.summary: Confirm production serves the merge, or ask the person to confirm it.

hotfix-close@1.summary: Close out the hotfix and say whether an open release branch must take it.

session-model@1.summary: Check the session's model against the role this workflow wants, and only report it.

plan-orient@1.summary: Resolve the plan root, its delivery profile and the organization's shape.

plan-ground@1.summary: Read what the plan already holds, read-only.

plan-discovery@1.summary: Ask the questions that change the shape, until the person says 'yes, build this'.

plan-sign-off-record@1.summary: Record the sign-off, and nothing else, in DevStride.

plan-draft@1.summary: Draft the specs for the signed-off shape; the drafting agents never write to DevStride.

plan-draft-approval@1.summary: Walk the person through the drafts until they approve them.

plan-create@1.summary: Create the approved tree top-down, only the items that are missing.

plan-wire@1.summary: Wire the dependency edges and prove no new leaf is left without one.

rationalize-gantt@1.summary: Date the plan from its dependency graph, with the auto-scheduler off.

plan-number@1.summary: Number the leaves in the order the build loop will pick them.

plan-hand-off@1.summary: Report the finished plan and where the build loop starts.

rebalance-gates@1.summary: Check that nothing else is writing to the plan and the arguments are whole.

rebalance-partition@1.summary: Separate the leaves that may be re-sliced from the ones that are untouchable.

rebalance-proposal@1.summary: Propose the merges or splits and wait for 'yes, rebalance'.

rebalance-probe@1.summary: Prove the auto-scheduler will not overwrite what the rebalance writes.

rebalance-successors@1.summary: Create each merged story with the original specs preserved.

rebalance-rewire@1.summary: Move every absorbed item's edges to its successor, adding before removing.

rebalance-renumber@1.summary: Give each successor the number slot of its first absorbed item.

rebalance-archive@1.summary: Archive the originals only after their successors have edges.

rebalance-marker@1.summary: Rewrite the plan root's delivery profile line, and only that line.

rebalance-report@1.summary: Report the re-sliced plan and the next item the build loop will pick.

splice@1.summary: Splice one story or defect into a live plan, wired and dated for the build loop.
